name: Consensus API
desc: REST API for searching 400 million scholarly articles.
desc_zh: 检索四亿篇学术论文的 REST 接口
solves: Building literature search into your own tool means scraping or buying an index. One endpoint returns ranked papers, study metadata and full-text excerpts with citations.
solves_zh: 想让自己的工具能查文献，通常只能爬数据或买索引。一个接口就能返回排好序的论文、研究元数据和带引用的全文摘录。
best_for: You are wiring a research feature into your product and need peer-reviewed papers, not web pages.
best_for_zh: 你在给自己的产品接文献检索，需要的是同行评审论文，而不是网页。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://help.consensus.app/en/articles/11954907-consensus-product-changelog ）。 The changelog records application-based API access from 2026-05-13 ('you can apply for access to the API (general access coming soon!)' on the Launch Week page) and self-serve access for everyone on 2026-08-26; the recorded date is the self-serve launch because the earlier route was an application queue. Endpoints added since: full-text excerpts (2026-09-18), Threads (2026-10-21), full papers (2026-11-10), Get Citations and Get References in beta (2026-11-11). The docs list a deprecated /v1/quick_search endpoint to be removed 2027-02-07. Distinct from the ledger's Consensus web app. No media source was read. 首次公开日期来源：https://help.consensus.app/en/articles/11954907-consensus-product-changelog
